concerns.text: FR-005 (Sensitivity analysis on suitability threshold) is mapped to `code/evaluate.py`, but the plan does not explicitly describe the 'sweeping' mechanism or the specific threshold set to be swept. The spec requires 'sweeping absolute diff ∈ {low, specific magnitudes}', but the plan only mentions 'sensitivity analysis' generically without defining the sweep parameters or the correction method implementation details.

FR-009 (Niche stability test) is mapped to `code/project.py` and `code/evaluate.py`, but the plan lacks a clear description of the 'temporal validation' step (historical-to-historical projection) required to establish the baseline for comparison. The plan mentions 'future projection degradation' but does not explicitly state the implementation of the historical-to-historical projection needed to calculate the degradation metric.

FR-010 (Non-parametric permutation tests) is mapped to `code/evaluate.py`, but the plan does not specify which test (permutation vs. bootstrapped CI) will be used or how the 'dependence structure' of AUC/TSS metrics will be accounted for in the implementation. The spec requires a specific statistical approach to handle dependence, which is not detailed in the plan.

SC-001 (Predictive performance against baseline) is mentioned as 'measured against baseline expectation', but the plan does not define what this baseline is (e.g., random chance, null model, or historical-to-historical performance). Without a defined baseline, the success criterion cannot be measured.

SC-003 (Sensitivity analysis results) requires reporting 'headline rates (false-positive/negative) across the swept threshold set', but the plan does not specify how these rates will be calculated or reported in the output metrics. The plan mentions 'sensitivity results reported' but lacks the specific metric definitions required by the SC.
